video_title: Draymond Green on His Free Agent Pitch To LeBron, Bam/Tyler Herro Fight And Responds To Stephen A

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green addresses reports of him spending time with LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I don't have problems with Shams. I think he's great at what he does. Sometimes things step outside
quotes.quote: Shams reported that LeBron and myself were spending some time together last week. Listen, I don't have problems with Shams. I think he's great at what he does. I think sometimes things step outside the scope of work, and reported whereabouts I think is a little outside of the scope of work. I also think it's kind of a bit irrelevant because, obviously, LeBron, that's my brother. We've built quite the relationship, and so I think us hanging out, us kicking it together, us golfing together, whatever it is, I don't think it's really that newsworthy because it's not like, oh my god, they've never hung out before, and now all of a sudden free agency is going on and they're hanging out. I don't think that is as relevant as if say, I was going to hang out with like, yo, Draymond's a free agent, he's going to hang out with Victor Wembanyama because, like, I think that'd be more relevant.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green responds to Stephen A. Smith's criticism about dancing around issues
quotes.excerpt: When you have sources, you protect sources. You bring up Jaylen Brown, but Jaylen Brown challenging me
quotes.quote: Stephen A. went on to say, 'Draymond, when are you going to stop dancing around issues involving me and tell them what's up?' You and I were pretty tight, and then after the choking incident with Rudy Gobert and the slap to Yusuf Nurkic, I upset you because I called you and said it's difficult to defend you. We've never talked since that. When you have sources, you protect sources. You bring up Jaylen Brown, but Jaylen Brown challenging me to a debate because of something that I've said or whatever. You forgot the fact that I did sit down with him face-to-face in Boston a year ago after he had a problem with what I said, when all I said was what other people were thinking while defending him for years. We're just going to ignore the fact that I defend him for years and ignore the fact that I was complimentary about him for years and ignore the fact that I have always treated this brother with reverence.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Donovan Mitchell's contract extension and the collective bargaining system
quotes.excerpt: When you get into the $70 million range, there may only be a couple players in the league
quotes.quote: Donovan Mitchell agreed on a four-year $273 million maximum contract extension that includes a player option in the 2030-2031 season with a full trade kicker. ESPN's Tim McMahon, one of the GMs, said in terms of this kind of money, you've got to be a generational talent. When you get into the $70 million range, there may only be a couple players in the league that are worth that kind of money. What this GM is saying is pretty much what I was saying the other day, which is, when I speak of 1A guys, there's just not many of them in the NBA. I know people get that moniker and get that tag, but there's just not many 1As. By the way, this is nothing to do with my thoughts on Donovan Mitchell. This is just me explaining this take to y'all. This take is simply just saying what I said, which is, there's just not many 1A guys in this league. There's guys that's built as 1A guys, but there's just not many.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green discusses the non-existent off-court relationship between Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: That shit don't matter. We all have different lives. Jaylen Brown has no kids and is single
quotes.quote: Shams reported that Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown had a non-existent off-court relationship. My thoughts on this are as follows: That shit don't matter. We all have different lives. Jaylen Brown has no kids and to my understanding, is single. Jayson Tatum has two kids and is in a relationship. That right there alone sets the stage to live two completely different lives. Does not mean they don't like each other. Does not mean they hate each other. It simply means we don't carry the same interests off the basketball court. And by the way, that has nothing to do with relationship or being a teammate. They simply just cannot carry the same interest off the basketball court. None of you people who sit and judge, hang out with every colleague that you work with. But for some reason, when it comes to basketball players, if two guys don't hang out, it's a big issue. It's not.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green reflects on his relationship with Stephen Curry
quotes.excerpt: I've been playing with Steph Curry for 14 years. Love Steph Curry to death. It's my brother
quotes.quote: I've been playing with Steph Curry for 14 years. Love Steph Curry to death. It's my brother, been to hell and back with him. We don't hang out all the time off the basketball court. By the way, during the summertime, we don't talk much at all. Every now and then, I check in with him, every now and then he got to get a text, so he check in with me. We don't talk a bunch at all. Does that mean we don't have a great relationship? Or does that mean you're doing what you're doing, I'm doing what I'm doing, and because our relationship is so close, once we pick back up, we're in the same beat. Does that say more about the relationship, or does that mean Steph Curry living in the Bay Area in the Peninsula and he's there for the majority of the summer, and I'm not there the majority of the summer, and he's with his kids and I'm with my kids?

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green discusses the Kings waiving DeMar DeRozan
quotes.excerpt: DeMar is set to make $10 million. I think they stretched it out over the course of three
quotes.quote: Sacramento Kings waived DeMar DeRozan. DeMar is set to make $10 million. I think they stretched it out over the course of three to five years. But DeMar, of the $25 million, $10 million was guaranteed. He is now set to be a free agent. When you look at DeMar, I think what's going to put him in the best situation is being open to any situation. Because the reason I say that is, when you're a player of DeMar's stature, people, we all have egos, we all have representation, we all have beliefs. And when you're a player of that stature, that amount of points with that amount of production in the NBA, obviously it comes with an ego. You don't become that guy if you don't have somewhat of an ego.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green shouts out Quinten Post's signing with the Memphis Grizzlies
quotes.excerpt: Shout out to my young fella Quinten Post, one of my favorite Dutchmen. Three-year $30 million offer sheet
quotes.quote: Shout out to my young fella Quinten Post, one of my favorite Dutchmen. Three-year $30 million offer sheet with the Grizzlies that the Warriors did not match. QP will be a Memphis Grizzly making $10 million a year and I couldn't be more happy for him. Watch this kid come in, 52nd pick, 56th pick, 52nd pick somewhere around there on a two-way contract, spend a lot of time in the G League, gets an opportunity, shoots the lights out of the ball, plays well, comes back the next year, grow as a defender, just continue to grow as a player and get rewarded. Mark Bartelstein strikes again. You go get an offer sheet that you know a team is not going to match to get that kid paid. Restricted free agency is a shit place, man. You talk about the system being broken by the way, we go back up. Restricted free agency is another, it's a shitty place.
